__inputs.description: Azure Data Explorer datasource configured for the Foundry Local Aria cluster.
__inputs.label: Aria Azure Data Explorer
__inputs.name: DS_ARIA_ADX

options.content: Foundry Local SDK v2 client telemetry from Aria. Filters are multi-select and time-aware. Device IDs are used only for aggregate distinct counts; this dashboard never displays device, client-IP, or user-identity values. Aria retention is approximately 12–14 days.

panels.description: Exact distinct process-wide application sessions represented by ProcessInfo.

targets.query:
processinfo
| where $__timeFilter(EventInfo_Time)
| where isnotempty(FoundryLocalVersion)
| extend FLApp=coalesce(AppName, appName),
         FLOS=coalesce(OsName, osName, os),
         FLVersion=coalesce(FoundryLocalVersion, Version, libraryVersion)
| where $__contains(FLApp, $fl_app)
| where $__contains(FLOS, $fl_os)
| where $__contains(FLVersion, $fl_version)
| where isnotempty(AppSessionGuid)
| summarize Value=count_distinct(AppSessionGuid)

panels.title: Process sessions
